image.name: vlc
image.description: [VLC Media Player](https://www.videolan.org/vlc/) is a free and open source cross-platform multimedia player and framework that delivers dependable performance across multiple devices.

changelog.desc: Make Wayland default disable with PIXELFLUX_WAYLAND=false.

env_vars.name: VLC_CLI
env_vars.desc: Specify one or multiple VLC CLI flags, this string will be passed to the application in full.

volumes.desc: Users home directory in the container, stores local files and settings

ports.desc: VLC Media Player desktop gui HTTP must be proxied.
VLC Media Player desktop gui HTTPS.

image.title: Vlc
image.setup_instructions:
The application can be accessed at:

* https://yourhost:3001/

snippets.docker_compose:
---
services:
  vlc:
    image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/vlc:latest
    container_name: vlc
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=Etc/UTC
      - VLC_CLI=--no-qt-minimal-view #optional
    volumes:
      - /path/to/config:/config
    ports:
      - 3000:3000
      - 3001:3001
    shm_size: "1gb"
    restart: unless-stopped
snippets.docker_run:
docker run -d \
  --name=vlc \
  -e PUID=1000 \
  -e PGID=1000 \
  -e TZ=Etc/UTC \
  -e VLC_CLI=--no-qt-minimal-view `#optional` \
  -p 3000:3000 \
  -p 3001:3001 \
  -v /path/to/config:/config \
  --shm-size="1gb" \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/vlc:latest
